summary: Global Navigation Bar Layout Design & Shell
description: Build the global layout wrapper for the navigation bar, including brand logo slot, user profile icon container, and desktop links spacing.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Fixed or sticky layout persists at top of page;AC2: Flexbox layout maintains consistent padding on desktop screens;AC3: Placeholder profile block renders user initial or default image.

summary: Navigation Link Routing & Active State Styling
description: Implement interactive client-side routing pathways linking the navbar layout directly to the Leave Form and Leave Balance routes. Add focus and active link styles.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Clicking a link changes the route without full page reloads;AC2: The current active route link is visually highlighted (different font color/border);AC3: Focus outline is visible when keyboard navigating links.

description: Develop the client-side code for the mobile hamburger button toggle, slide-out link navigation drawer overlay, and semi-transparent background dimming shield.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Clicking the hamburger icon toggles the visibility of the nav menu drawer smoothly;AC2: Click on background shield dimming backdrop closes the open drawer layout immediately;AC3: Navigation menu remains fully interactive within the slide-out drawer area.

description: Apply CSS media query breakpoint optimizations to hide standard horizontal navigation items and display the hamburger toggle trigger at 375px width resolutions with no layout breakage.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Standard desktop layout link items hidden entirely below 768px viewports;AC2: Hamburger component icon triggers visibility correctly at 375px;AC3: No unwanted horizontal webpage scrollbars are generated by the overflow elements.

description: Add conditional client-side access control rendering wrappers inside the navigation link tree map array to prevent non-manager accounts from viewing permission-restricted link items.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Accounts possessing Employee roles do not see or click Manager Approval Link paths in the navbar component;AC2: Accounts with Manager claims cleanly render the extra Approval Queue route link tab entry.
